保证金不够，先存入 USDT: Not enough margin. Deposit USDT first
已挂单，成交后会出现在持仓里: Order placed. It will show in Positions once filled
钱包已锁定，验证后查看账户: Wallet locked. Verify to view your account
还没有合约账户。点「存入」把 BNB Chain 上的 USDT 转进来即可开通: No perps account yet. Tap Deposit to move USDT on BNB Chain in and open one. Arrives in about 1–3 minutes.
还没有资金。点「存入」把 BNB Chain 上的 USDT 转进来，约 1–3: No funds yet. Tap Deposit to move USDT on BNB Chain in. Arrives in about 1–3 minutes.
账户更新失败，以上为上次读取的数据。: Couldn't refresh the account. Showing the last loaded data.
暂时无法读取账户：{err}: Can't load the account right now: {err}
还没有自选。进入币种页点右上角的星标加入。: No watchlist yet. Open a coin and tap the star at the top right to add it.
合约有强平风险，杠杆越高越容易归零。订单由你自己的钱包签名，平台不经手资金。: Perps carry liquidation risk, and higher leverage makes it easier to lose everything. Orders are signed by your own wallet; the platform never holds your funds.
暂时无法读取合约行情: Can't load market data right now
仓位价值最少 ${min}，交易所会拒掉更小的单。: Position value must be at least ${min}. The exchange rejects smaller orders.
可用保证金只剩 {free}，{lev}x 下最多开 {max}，不够最低的 $: Only {free} margin available. At {lev}x you can open up to {max}, below the ${min} minimum. Close an existing position or deposit more USDT.
只减仓（这笔单只会减少现有仓位，不会反向开新仓）: Reduce only (this order can only shrink your current position, never open one in the other direction)
已把 {n} BNB 换成 USDT 存入，约 1–3 分钟到账: Swapped {n} BNB to USDT and deposited. Arrives in about 1–3 minutes
已存入 {n} USDT，约 1–3 分钟到账: Deposited {n} USDT. Arrives in about 1–3 minutes
已提出，几分钟内到账 BNB Chain: Withdrawn. Arrives on BNB Chain within a few minutes
用钱包里 {chain} 上的 USDT 存入合约账户，最少 {min} USD: Deposit USDT on {chain} from your wallet into your perps account. Minimum {min} USDT, arrives in about 1–3 minutes. The fee is paid in BNB (about $0.05).
你的 BNB 会按当前价格换成 USDT，存进合约账户。之后保证金一直按 USD: Your BNB is swapped to USDT at the current price and deposited into your perps account. Your margin stays in USDT, so BNB price moves won't affect it.
过程中需要在钱包里确认 2 到 3 次，请留 {n} BNB 作为网络手续费。: You'll confirm 2 to 3 times in your wallet. Keep {n} BNB for network fees.
提回你钱包的 {chain} 地址，手续费约 {fee} USDT（按当时网络费: Withdraw to your wallet's {chain} address. Fee is about {fee} USDT (estimated from current network fees). Arrives within a few minutes.
另需约 {amount} SOL 作为领取手续费: Needs about {amount} SOL extra for claim fees
另需少量原生币作为领取 Gas: Needs a little native coin extra for claim gas
从你的平台余额扣，群友抢到直接进余额，秒到无 Gas。我的余额 {balance: Paid from your in-app balance. Claims land straight in members' balances, instantly with no gas. My balance {balance}
红包资金会先转入一个一次性托管地址，24 小时内未领完的部分自动退回给你。: Funds first go to a one-time escrow address. Anything unclaimed after 24 hours is refunded to you automatically.
这个周期内还没有卖出记录，曲线在第一笔卖出后出现: No sells in this period yet. The chart appears after the first sell
没有找到这个合约的交易对，请确认地址是否正确、是否已上线 DEX: No trading pairs found for this contract. Check the address and that it's listed on a DEX
行情接口暂时不可达，请稍后再试: Market data is unreachable right now. Try again later
无法读取剪贴板，请手动粘贴: Can't read the clipboard. Paste manually
粘贴合约地址（支持 Solana 与所有 EVM 链）: Paste a contract address (Solana and all EVM chains)
这个地址在多条链上都有代币，请选择：: This address has tokens on multiple chains. Choose one:
收藏后会出现在「发现 → 收藏」里，任何链上的代币都可以用你钱包里的任意资产直接: Favorites appear under Discover → Favorites. You can buy tokens on any chain with any asset in your wallet.
没有相册权限，请在系统设置里允许 0x4 添加照片: No Photos access. Allow 0x4 to add photos in system Settings
合约交易的保证金用 BNB Chain 上的 USDT，手续费用 BNB: Perps margin uses USDT on BNB Chain, and fees are paid in BNB
价格变动超过滑点，请重新获取报价: Price moved beyond your slippage. Get a new quote
搜索符号、名称或合约地址: Search symbol, name or contract address
没有可用于支付的资产: No assets available to pay with
从你的余额转出，对方秒到，免手续费: Sent from your balance. Arrives instantly, no fee
界面遇到了一个错误。你的钱包和资产不受影响。: The app hit an error. Your wallet and assets are not affected.
以下网络都用这一个地址: All networks below use this one address
SOL 及 Solana 上的所有代币: SOL and all tokens on Solana
